test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

You must / be hurry, / otherwise you will / miss the train.
solution:
The correct answer is **"be hurry,".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• In the given question, there is **an error** in the **second segment.**
 
• **"Be"** should not be used before the verb** "hurry"**.
 
• The sentence should be **"You must hurry".**

**Correct sentence:** You must hurry, otherwise you will miss the train.
